Cover page: "Anticipatory Action Framework — Burkina Faso, Sécheresse" (drought), OCHA. No figure, title page only.

--- page 2 ---
French executive summary narrative text. Mentions the framework covers Boucle de Mouhoun, Centre-Nord, Sahel and Nord regions ("zone d'intérêt"), targeting 300,000+ people. Describes 3 triggers: Trigger 1 (March, SEAS5 forecast, ≥10% of area with Jun-Jul-Aug rainfall in lowest historical quintile), Trigger 2 (July, SEAS5 forecast, ≥10% of area with Aug-Sep-Oct rainfall in lowest quintile), Trigger 3 (October, ASAP biomass Level 4 alert in ≥1 region). No chart/map on this page, narrative text only.

Table "Statistiques du mécanisme de déclenchement" (analysis years 2001-2024): Trigger 1 (SEAS5 mars) return period 10 yrs, activation probability 10%, activated years 2009/2010/2019; Trigger 2 (SEAS5 juillet) return period 10 yrs, probability 10%, activated 2019/2020; Trigger 3 (Alertes ASAP) return period 4.0 yrs, probability 24%, activated 2002/2004/2006/2009/2011/2019. Global stats: overall return period 3.1 yrs, effective return period 4.8 yrs, overall activation probability 32%, effective probability 21%, avg total spend/year with activation $9.3M, avg total spend/year $3.1M. Below: CERF funding table by agency — FAO $5,500,000, PAM/WFP $5,500,000, UNICEF $3,600,000, UNHCR $200,000, UNFPA $200,000, Total $15,000,000.

--- page 9 ---
Two maps: (1) "ZONES CLIMATIQUES DU BURKINA FASO (1981-2010)" — climate zones map showing Sahélien (north, ~600mm annual rainfall), Soudano-sahélien (center, 600-900mm), and Soudanien (south, 900+mm) bands with isohyets and town labels (Djibo, Dori, Ouagadougou, Bobo-Dioulasso, etc.). (2) "Drought risk" map of Burkina Faso (Source: WFP, 1981-2015) with High (red, concentrated in Sahel/north — Djibo/Dori area), Medium (orange, central band), Low (yellow, south/southwest) risk zones. Text notes agriculture = 1/3 of GDP, 80% of livelihoods; 46% of population below poverty line; 1969-2014 droughts cumulatively affected 12.4 million people.

--- page 10 ---
Four thematic maps of Burkina Faso in a 2x2 grid: (1) Multidimensional poverty index by region, scale 0.1-0.7, darkest (0.6-0.7) in west/southwest and north (Source: Oxford Poverty and Human Development Initiative, 2020). (2) Number of IDPs by region, 0 to 500,000 scale, highest (400-500k, dark red) concentrated in north-central regions (Sahel/Centre-Nord area) (Source: OCHA, 2020). (3) Population by region, 500k-3,000,000 scale, highest around central region incl. Ouagadougou (Source: OCHA, 2019). (4) Population in IPC/CH Phase 3+ (food insecurity), 0-1,200,000 scale, highest concentrations (800k-1.2M) in north-central regions (Source: FSNWG, 2020, averaged across year). Below: two Cadre Harmonisé food insecurity maps comparing Oct-Nov-Dec 2021 vs Jun-Jul-Aug 2022 projections — phase colors from Phase 1 (green/none) to Phase 5 (famine); 2022 map shows expanded Phase 3 (crisis, orange) and Phase 4 (urgence, dark red) zones especially in Sahel/Nord/Centre-Nord provinces vs 2021, plus hatched "zone à accès limité" (limited access) areas.

--- page 26 ---
Narrative text defining SPI-1 threshold (<-1.5 on ≥30% of zone) and WRSI threshold (<75 on ≥30% of zone) as OR-combined observational triggers. Table: monitoring schedule by month (Juillet/Août/Septembre) x indicator (SPI-1, WRSI) showing observed period and calculation date (e.g., Juillet SPI-1 observed 2-31 Jul, calculated 3 Aug). Below: timeline diagram "Saison des pluies" (Jan-Nov) showing "Moment potentiel d'activation" markers at Mars, Juillet (forecast-based, purple) and Août/Septembre/Octobre (observation-based, green), with threshold box: SPI<-1.5 OR WRSI<75 on ≥30% of zone (~28.5% activation probability, 1 year in 3.5).

--- page 32 ---
"Annexe 3 – Mise à jour février 2025 : déclencheur" (trigger update). Narrative on 3-step trigger revision process. Scatter plot "Déclencheurs avec période de retour combinée acceptable" — x-axis: période de retour individuelle des prévisions (ans, 5-25), y-axis: période de retour des alertes ASAP (ans, 5-25); points colored by combined return period (3.1=blue, 3.6=green, 4.2=orange, 5.0=purple), symbols encode ASAP AND/OR condition, number of regions required, and alert level. Chosen option is in bottom-left corner (lowest return periods = higher combined activation probability, favoring observational triggers).

--- page 33 ---
Table "Mesures d'exactitude" (accuracy metrics, analysis years 2006-2024) by trigger: 1. SEAS5 mars — Exactitude 68%, Taux de détection 20%, Taux de fausse alarme 14%, Précision 33%, Score F1 25%. 2. SEAS5 juillet — 74%, 20%, 7%, 50%, 29%. 3. Alertes ASAP — 74%, 40%, 14%, 50%, 44%. Globale — 63%, 40%, 29%, 33%, 36%. Below: scatter plot "Déclenchements historiques des prévisions SEAS, depuis 2001 (période de retour combinée = 6,25 ans)" — x-axis: prévision de mars centile historique JJA precip (0-100e), y-axis: prévision de juillet centile historique ASO precip (0-100e); threshold lines at 20th percentile on both axes forming trigger zones (orange = March-only trigger years incl. 2009/2010, purple = July-only incl. 2020, dark/black = both incl. 2019); most other years (2001,2004-2008,2011-2018,2021-2023) scattered above thresholds (not triggered).
